context:
Extract a `_generate_table(self, conn, table_name, num_records, insert_sql)`
helper that handles: progress logging, timing via mono_time/elapsed_seconds,
conn.execute(insert_sql), stats dict updates (records_generated, tables_generated,
generation_times, sql_operations), completion logging.

The helper should accept an optional `num_records` parameter. When provided,
it is used for stats and logging. When None, the helper extracts the count
from the query result (as generate_time_dimension currently does).

Each of the 6 generator methods reduces to: compute count (if known),
build SQL string, call self._generate_table(conn, "TableName", count, sql).
description:
Group 4 from the duplicate-check report identifies 6 methods with identical
scaffolding in benchbox/core/tpcdi/generator/sql.py:
- generate_time_dimension (line ~225)
- generate_company_dimension (line 263)
- generate_security_dimension (line 315)
- generate_customer_dimension (line 359)
- generate_account_dimension (line 427)
- generate_trade_facts (line 467)

All 6 share the same pattern: progress log → mono_time() → conn.execute(sql)
→ elapsed_seconds → stats update (4 keys) → completion log → return count.
Only the SQL INSERT body and record count computation differ.

Note: generate_time_dimension extracts its record count from the query result
rather than pre-computing it. generate_account_dimension derives its count
from a formula (num_customers * 1.5) rather than base_X * scale_factor.

anti_patterns.dont: assume record count is always a pre-computed variable
anti_patterns.instead: the helper must accept an optional count and fall back to result extraction
anti_patterns.why: generate_time_dimension extracts it from the query result

anti_patterns.dont: hardcode count formula as base_X * scale_factor
anti_patterns.instead: each caller computes its own count before invoking the helper

preserves.behavior: Progress logging messages include table name and record count
generate_time_dimension returns count extracted from query result, not pre-computed
generation_stats dict populated identically after each dimension generation

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/ -v -k tpcdi

work_units.summary: Extract _generate_table helper and refactor all 6 generator methods to use it
Run TPC-DI tests to verify no regressions
